name: Depeche Mode (style) — C minor 118
description: Modelled on the sound of Depeche Mode — original parts, not any of their songs: 808-style electronic beat with claps and metallic percussion, 16th-note sequenced synth bass, saw arpeggios, choir pad, synth-brass stabs, a tubular-bell melody and a twangy guitar riff. C minor at 118 bpm, Cm Ab Fm G. Rows 1-4 drums (ch 10), 5-8 bass SUBROUTINES and 9-B bass rows (ch 13), C-F arp SUBROUTINES and G arps (ch 11), H-I pad (ch 15), J stabs (ch 16), K-L bells (ch 11), M guitar (ch 14), N-R sections, S jam. Row 0 plays the song.
prompt: build a new bank modelled after the band The Cure and make one modelled after the band Depeche Mode and make one modelled after Joe Jackson
